Text Box 2: Marine was formed in 1992 by the merger of Swindon Athletic and Supermarine.
Supermarine began as a Vickers works team in 1946, taking its name from the aircraft maker behind the Spitfire.
Marine play in South Marston at the Imagine Cruising Stadium, formerly Webbswood Stadium.
Text Box 3: The club reached Southern Premier South via the 2017/18 play-offs.
Relegation in 2024/25 brought Marine back to Division One South.
Their 2025/26 review highlighted a stronger second half and progress by younger players.
